flaw_explanation: Cardboard is strongest when the flutes of adjacent layers run perpendicular to each other, because crossing the ridges spreads load in both directions and prevents the panels from bending along the flute lines. Aligning all layers the same direction gives no added stiffness in the weak direction, so the cabinets will still flex and could waste the group's glue and building time.
